prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 13 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean, simple line drawing: uniform thin black outlines on a plain white background, with no shading, hatching, grey tones, colour or texture. Each panel has a thin black border, with plain white gutters between the panels. Location: The Quinn family mansion, living room, Day, bright daylight through the arched French windows, warm chandelier fill.
Image 1: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S0
Image 2: the character sheet of George (55), look S0
Image 3: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S0
Image 4: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S0
Image 5: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 6: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 8: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 9: the location The Quinn family mansion, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 10: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 11: the prop hospital statement; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image: the hairstyle, build and outfit in outline. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Axis: the line from the single cream armchair to the long cream sofa. The camera stays on the front (bookshelf) wall side and looks toward the three tall arched French windows on the back wall; reverse singles on Natalie look toward the bookshelf wall. The one long cream sofa runs across the frame in front of the windows and faces the camera. The white marble fireplace is on the left wall at frame left. The open white double doorway is on the right wall at frame right. The one single cream armchair stands in the foreground centre with its back to the camera, facing the sofa across the one low glass-and-gold coffee table. Natalie sits in the armchair, three-quarter back to the camera, facing the sofa, hands clasped in her lap. George sits at the fireplace end of the sofa, frame left, eyes lowered. Lauren sits at the doorway end of the sofa, frame right, at the same depth as George, turned toward him. The one hospital statement lies flat on the coffee table. Cassie is not yet in the room; she waits out of sight in the marble entrance hall beyond the double doorway.
Panel 1: Wide shot, locked-off camera from the bookshelf wall, eye-level. Cassie appears in the open double doorway at frame right with a mocking pout. Natalie in the foreground armchair, and George and Lauren on the sofa, all turn their heads right toward her.
Panel 2: Medium shot, low angle, tracking Cassie from the doorway at frame right leftward to the armchair. Cassie strolls across the rug from the doorway and stops beside the armchair on its doorway side, frame right of Natalie, standing over the seated Natalie.
Panel 3: Medium shot, low angle on Cassie, dirty single with the top of Natalie's head at the frame-left edge. Cassie looks down at Natalie with a smirk, one hand on her hip.
Panel 4: Close-up, high angle, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall. Only Natalie, framed tight on her face; she lowers her eyes, her jaw tightening.
Panel 5: Medium shot from the front, eye-level. Natalie picks up the hospital statement from the coffee table and rises from the armchair; Cassie, at the armchair's frame-right side, steps back half a pace toward the doorway.
Panel 6: Medium shot, handheld, following Natalie rightward toward the double doorway at frame right. Natalie walks past Cassie toward the double doorway, the statement in her hand, and stops a few steps short of the doorway.
Panel 7: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Cassie with Natalie's shoulder at the frame-right edge. Cassie spins right toward Natalie and raises one hand with a sly smile.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, clean single on Natalie near the doorway. Only Natalie, framed on her face and shoulders; she stops and half-turns back toward the room, the statement pressed to her side.
Panel 9: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front. Lauren at frame right sits up straight on the sofa and stares at Cassie; George at frame left looks up beside her.
Panel 10: Close-up, slight low angle, clean single on Cassie. Only Cassie, framed tight on her face; she tilts her head right toward Natalie with a cruel little smile.
Panel 11: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Lauren with George's shoulder at the frame-left edge, slow push in. Lauren breaks into a delighted smile and points proudly toward Cassie.
Panel 12: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Cassie's shoulder, from the front. Natalie, wide-eyed and gripping the statement, steps back from the doorway past Cassie and ends beside the armchair on its frame-right side, with Cassie now next to her, nearer the doorway.
Panel 13: Medium close-up, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall, handheld. Only Natalie, framed on her face and shoulders; she shakes her head slightly in disbelief.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering, shading or colour.
